notes.title: ABMS v2.07: Avalanche and Squall changes. Operation Logs, Dark maps fixed
notes.notes:
ABMS patch v2.07 has been released. The major changes are:

[list]
[*] Avalanche mission fixed crashing
[*] Avalanche fixed using abilities when offline, range increased
[*] Squall not having fighter movement
[*] Operation 3 fixed not having enough mission logs, crashing the game. Rewrote old SBMS mission logs
[*] Dark maps added for missions that didn't have them
[*] Stormbreaker beam pressure increased from 20 to 25
[/list]

These crashes are a pretty severe oversight. I apologise for that.
